name: nexus
description: Persistent code intelligence with three capabilities over one index. Architect says what a project is built from and what working in it lacks; Review says what a change reaches and whether anything tests it; BugHunter finds Spring proxy mistakes and GraphQL fields no resolver serves. Nexus indexes a project once and remembers its structure, its history and what has gone wrong in it — then answers what changed, what that touches across the frontend/backend seam, and what is already known about the code you are about to edit.
